description: The arrow indicates slight alteration of the ST-T wave by a PAC.  The PAC, in turn, falls during the vulnerable period of atrial repolarization and initiates atrial fibrillation.  Similar but more catastrophic events happen in the ventricles when PVC's occur during the vulnerable period, i.e. R-on-T, of ventricular repolarization
